description: Actual five-replica slow path: row 4 preacceptance reaches peer 1 while its copy to owner 0 stays pending. Owner 0 then receives different real replies from peers 1 and 2 and emits Accept. Each eligible recipient acknowledges; a higher Prepare generated by coordinator 3 obtains that same recipient's status. Compare the report against the accepted-support threshold.

harness.description: Synchronous bounded allocations with production handlers, RPC factory and codecs; one explicit delivery schedule.
semantic_changes: Allocate eight slots per row instead of MAX_INSTANCE and omit autonomous networking/execution/timers.
Buffer-backed SendMsg replaces sockets; dispatch selected emitted messages once; other messages remain pending.
Emit correlated observations without changing target protocol state or behavior.

legality.derivation: The helper was rechecked for this N=5,F=2 history rather than treated as transferring the previous result. Constructor defaults and preferred cyclic peer order match relevant S-init/S-members state. Owner 4 emits PreAccept to peers 0 and 1; only 1 dispatches it. Owner 0 independently emits its target to peers 1 and 2. Their actual serialized replies differ because 1 knows the conflicting row-4 command, and handlePreAcceptReply reaches ACCEPTED and bcastAccept. The test checks this prerequisite and selected dependency before delivery. Each Accept is read from the actual owner output, eligibility is checked against live state, and a complete matching AcceptReply is decoded before admission. Its delivery to owner protocol logic remains pending, so no fabricated Commit or global decision is involved. Coordinator 3 uses startRecoveryForInstance to construct its higher Prepare; the automatic timer trigger is outside the local reporting obligation. The same producer/codec paths produce and decode the later report. Per-link selected-message order is respected; messages left pending on other links do not justify any endpoint claim. All state reads occur with a single synchronous owner, and no waits/shutdown phases are used.
legality.applicability: N=5 F=2, owner row0 instance0, acceptors1 and2; existing conflicting row4 instance0; distinct coordinator3; both acceptance cases selected before output.

grounding.derivation: The admission event is emitted only after actual eligibility, complete matching acknowledgment and installed attributes are checked. Later report identity comes from decoded PrepareReply. recognized_accepted_support is the expression report.Status>=ACCEPTED using the target phase constants; raw status is retained. This boolean encodes the required phase ordering, not overall recovery success. Ballot changes legitimately and is not an identity filter.
grounding.applicability: The independently selected two recipients each owe a subsequent report in this fixed local schedule.

observable_properties.description: The higher Prepare reports at least ACCEPTED support for the previously acknowledged instance.

uncertainties: No decision divergence or automatic recovery liveness is asserted.
Known PrepareReply VBallot omission is retained and not repaired; this predicate only compares Status, whose codec transfer is observed.
